rows.behavior: publish with a report whose findings are all below --min-severity (default high) calls gh for nothing, exits 0 and says no issue was written.
rows.fails_when: gh is called to list, create or edit an issue, or the exit code is not 0

rows.behavior: publish with a finding at or above --min-severity creates the issue titled --title when none is open, and edits the open one when it is; the body holds the rendered report and, when GITHUB_RUN_ID is set, a link to the run.
rows.fails_when: no issue is created, a second one is created instead of editing the open one, or the body lacks a finding or the run link

rows.behavior: The issue body @-mentions the owners of the last * rule in CODEOWNERS, found in .github/, the root or docs/ in GitHub's order; --mention (repeatable) replaces them; with neither, it mentions no one.
rows.fails_when: owners from another rule or file are mentioned, --mention does not replace them, or a mention line appears with no owners

rows.behavior: publish exits 1 when gh fails and writes no issue, and exits 2 with a message for a missing or invalid report.json.
rows.fails_when: a gh failure exits 0, or a bad report is posted or crashes with a traceback

rows.behavior: action/knowledge-audit-issue.sh is gone; action.yml's audit mode and .github/workflows/knowledge-audit.yml run agent.py publish on report.json in the only step that gets GH_TOKEN, and action.yml has min_severity, mention and issue_title inputs passed to it.
rows.fails_when: the shell script remains, the issue step does not run publish, another step gets the token, or an input is missing or not passed

rows.behavior: ADR 0017 gets a correction, and the how-to and architecture overview describe publish, its threshold and the mentions; the bundle and docs check clean.
rows.fails_when: a page still names knowledge-audit-issue.sh or kmctl check fails
rows.command: uv run kmctl check && ! grep -rn 'knowledge-audit-issue' docs .okf/architecture action.yml .github

rows.behavior: All of the repository's gates pass.
rows.fails_when: just lint or just test fails

rows.behavior: publish --help names every option, what it takes and its default.
rows.fails_when: an option lacks a description or its default
